backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing posts, media, user profiles, and access control with admin-gated CRUD operations and entitlement checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that updates stored posts, rewriting createdAt to a fixed timestamp while preserving other state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report placeholder with an empty features list.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining color variables, dark mode values, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the main React app into the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Router setup defining root, home, post, and admin routes wrapped in AppLayout.
Component that blocks non-admin users from viewing admin pages and shows loading or denial states.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: Admin UI for granting, revoking, and checking principal access permissions with validation and toasts.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App-wide layout with theme provider, nav bar, footer, and toast system.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Error-state component showing a message and optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Gallery displaying image and video attachments via direct blob URLs.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Handles selecting and uploading image/video files to a post with progress tracking and status feedback.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Renders the top navigation bar with links, logo, and admin-only access to the admin page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks whether the current authenticated user is an admin by querying the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, and identity management utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for posts, access control, and media operations via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables, typography, and utility classes for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, providing query and identity context providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for creating, editing, deleting posts, managing allowlist, and uploading media.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Lists posts with loading/error states, sorts them by date, and renders cards with title, snippet, and lock status.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single post with date, media, and lock logic, handling locked content access via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/utils/date.ts: Formats Unix timestamps into Australia/Sydney locale date strings.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates and parses DFINITY Principal IDs, returning structured success or error info.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL or session-stored parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and content paths with custom extensions.
project_state.json: Describes project architecture, features, and known issues, including post timestamp bugs and admin edit failures.
